_comment: Database calls that already fail and are tracked, so CI flags only new ones (scripts/ci/check-rpc-calls.mjs). Each needs its register item in engineering/registers/tech-debt.md. Delete an entry when it is fixed; CI fails while a fixed entry is still listed.
